prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
sign_in, copy changes consistently worked, winning both tests with an average noise-corrected lift of +3.1%.
home, new_flow changes consistently failed, showing negative impacts across 2 tests (-2.6% average after noise correction).
home, wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence remains mixed for finish, new_screen, choose_path, hint, and adoption, redesign, as each kind had 1 winning test and 1 test with no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test completed.
Predictions were generally too high overall compared to actual noise-corrected results.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Account Recovery & Sync Sign-In Copy: Clarify on the sign-in screen that logging into an existing account immediately restores previous pets and saved progress. (why: 8 support emails reported missing or reset pets after signing back in, and previous sign_in copy changes showed a consistent +3.1% lift.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reordered Late Account Creation Flow: Move the sign-in screen to occur after pet selection and certificate adoption so users establish an account after building attachment to their pet. (why: Requiring sign-in before pet selection creates upfront friction, contributing to drop-offs before users customize their pet.)
2: [home, hint] Desktop Placement Verification Hint: Display an explicit positioning hint during the setup waiting screen explaining where the pet widget will anchor on the screen. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets did not appear on the desktop or that the app stalled during setup.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Companion Screen: Add a dedicated checklist screen (new_desktop_guide) detailing shortcut keys and desktop interaction options right before finishing. (why: 3 support messages cited confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet after completing onboarding.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Creation Step Guide New Flow: Insert a pre-upload step guide screen (new_custom_builder) providing photo quality requirements before custom pet creation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures and rendering errors.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Interaction Tip Carousel: Add a hint on the home intro screen providing key shortcuts for summoning and interacting with the desktop pet. (why: Post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding and talking to pets generated multiple support requests.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Instant Sign-In Benefit Headline Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body text to highlight multi-desktop pet sync and data protection. (why: Sign_in copy improvements have historically delivered a +3.1% lift, and account loss concerns are a top support theme.)
7: [finish, new_screen] Completion Celebration Screen: Add a cheerful celebration screen (new_pet_welcome) featuring an animated pet mascot right before launching to desktop. (why: Overall onboarding completion is low (24.9%), and finish step duration is long (median 395s / mean 5815s).)

scores.note: High support volume (8 emails) and sign_in copy changes have a proven track record (+3.1% average).
Flow restructuring carries high implementation cost and structural flow changes tend to fail or add friction.
Backed by 3 support emails, but home wait/hint changes have shown modest or neutral past results.
Addresses support complaints on desktop pet controls, though creating a new screen requires full release effort.
Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption, 34% lost), but introducing new_flow screens historically regressed conversion.
Addresses post-onboarding confusion with low friction UI hint, though evidence on hints remains mixed.
Zero code cost copy update on sign_in, supported by top support themes and consistent past copy test wins.
High cost for new screen release without direct support mail backing, despite finish step time friction.
